triage#1 · hotlong · session_01Q4EjjMnyLqJdzuktEmRPXH

Triage: lands in `domain:ui` · `pm:queue`; rationale: area:ux · Bug · an inline line grid (`inlineColumns`) never shows a field's `help` on the column header or cell, while the record form and detail page do; reach: every user entering lines through the grid, the normal way to fill a quote or order; severity: an entry convention (tax basis, unit, currency) is invisible where it matters; reproduced on 18.6.0 by an outside builder → p2 (UX rule: not every-user-every-time on a core action, so not p1; UX has no p3) · size S (grid header renders the existing help affordance).

repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CZrgaiMgTJCnswR6jQ

Claim: area ux-2 (`lease:ux-2`, leased by seat 5 at 11-21 03:28Z under Bill 11-21 03:25Z 「你继续处理 ux 非专题下的 p2 任务，并发3」) · 2026-11-21T03:32Z · folded with #35507 into one PR (both in `GridField.tsx`, per seat 11-21 03:28Z)
Area: ux-2
Session: `session_01Utp6CZrgaiMgTJCnswR6jQ`
Account: `os-bill`
Seat: `repo:objectstack#5`
Branch: `claude/issue-35507-grid-ghost-row-header-help`
Domain: `domain:ui`
File surface: `ui/packages/fields/src/widgets/GridField.tsx` (the trailing ghost row and the column header), its tests, i18n keys only if an existing one cannot serve, and a changeset. ⛔ No `packages/spec/**` (no new `inlineGhostRow` switch). Stop and report on any breach.
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Premise: holds on `origin/main`: the grid column header draws only the label. The fix shows the field's resolved help (the same text the record form shows, in the reader's language, including help written by `objectExtensions.fieldPatches`) as an info affordance on the header, reachable on hover and focus. It reuses the form's help affordance and keys where possible.
Serial constraints cleared: none. A live read of all 48 open PRs' files at claim time found none touching `GridField.tsx`. The last change on main is #35937 (c7174c36: new detail lines start on their defaults), which is read before editing.
Pre-claim deps: none. There is no parent issue.
Prior rulings read: hasGhost, isGhost, ghost, help, fieldPatches → ADR-0029 D8 and ADR-0106 D1 were hit on terms only, and neither binds this. The thread has no ruling.
Review path: L1-a. Approver handoff if Tier H or over 3,000 lines.

Claim amendment · area ux-2 · 2026-11-21T05:20Z · amends claim 7056679382 (one PR with #35507 / #35804, PR #35998)

File surface, added (all already in PR #35998 at `d4100395`; nothing new is edited by this amendment):
- `ui/packages/fields/src/index.tsx`: one export line (`columnHelpByField`).
- The three hosts that pass the grid its column help, read from the child object definition the record form already reads (`getObjectSchema`, which the server serves with `fieldPatches` applied and translated): `ui/packages/plugin-form/src/MasterDetailForm.tsx`, `LineItemsPanel.tsx`, `RecordBodyTableEditor.tsx`. The grid holds no field definition, so #35804's header help cannot be drawn from `GridField.tsx` alone.
- 23 plugin-form test files that typed into the removed trailing entry row. Each now presses Add first, and the expected lengths and batch payloads are unchanged. Two of them (`discardGuard.test.tsx`, `__tests__/modalMaximize-34604.test.tsx`) exercise ModalForm. `ModalForm.tsx` is untouched.
The ⛔ on `packages/spec/**`, `docs/adr/**` and the form tab/section-nav path stands, and none of them is touched.
Serial note: os-sales draft PR #35984 (#35940, opened 04:12Z, after this claim) also edits `GridField.tsx`, `MasterDetailForm.tsx` and their tests. A textual merge conflict exists in `MasterDetailForm.tsx`, `MasterDetailForm.test.tsx` and `GridField.test.tsx`. Whichever lands second merges `main`.
